setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json (admin). Meta lead submissions in <month> (seeded or real), a Meta contact <ad lead e-mail> that has no owner, an ad campaign <test ad code> created by the tester, and a user group <group> with active members. No case may submit leads, create contacts, move contact stages or send events to Meta.

evals.prompt: ¿Cuántos leads trajo cada campaña de Meta en <month>?
evals.expected_output: Runs the report by campaign for that month, gives leads per campaign split into new people and re-contacts, mentions the ad account's time zone, and writes nothing.
expectations: Uses scripts/ads.js report with --by campaign and the month's first and last day
Gives the total and the leads per campaign, separating new contacts from re-contacts
Mentions the time zone used (and reruns or offers --tz when the ad account uses another)
Does not add up spend from adCampaignMeta.stats
Answers in Spanish

evals.prompt: ¿Por qué el lead <ad lead e-mail> no tiene asesor asignado?
evals.expected_output: Runs diagnose, explains in plain words the routing it found (form, ad, group, Ad Hub owning the page) and proposes a routing change for future leads without writing.
expectations: Uses scripts/ads.js diagnose on that contact
Explains which of the form group, ad group or Ad Hub was missing
Says a routing change only affects new leads, not this contact
Writes nothing and does not reassign the contact

evals.prompt: Cambia el grupo de asesores que recibe los leads del anuncio <test ad code> al grupo <group>.
evals.expected_output: Previews a campaign-group plan, shows the members, whether the group rotates or shares a pool, and that only new people are routed; stops; after the yes applies and reads back.
expectations: Runs scripts/ads.js preview with a campaign-group plan, never a hand-made PATCH
Shows the group's members and its mode (round robin or pool) before writing
Writes nothing before the user's yes; after it, runs apply with --version and --confirmed
Reports the ad with its new group after the read-back

evals.prompt: Conecta la nueva cuenta publicitaria de Facebook y mándale a Meta un evento de prueba para el lead 1234567890.
evals.expected_output: Explains that connecting an ad account and sending the test event are done by an admin in the app, and does neither.
expectations: Does not call /v2/adhub/connect/… nor create an AdHub
Does not send any Conversions API event
Does not read credentials or tokens
Points to the Ad Hub screen of the app and answers in Spanish

evals.prompt: No están llegando los leads de Facebook, ¿qué está pasando?
evals.expected_output: Runs hubs, reports what it finds (connected ad accounts, pages, last lead per page, submissions setting) and explains which causes can only be checked in the app.
expectations: Uses scripts/ads.js hubs before concluding
States what the account shows (for example, no Ad Hub connected) with the last lead date when there is one
Names the causes outside the account (expired connection, leads without e-mail) and that reconnecting is done in the app
Writes nothing
